notes.title: Minor Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Mysterious Castle Players,

It’s been almost a month since we released Mysterious Castle. And we’ve received quite a response for our first steam release.

We have read and discussed all your reviews and comments along with any external reviews that there may have been published. And we realized there are many things we need to fix and we need to add.

So here we start with the first update. We’ve added a special cursor for the game that changes when pointing at interactive items, giving the player a little hint. We never intended to have a full fledged hint system in the game. Yet, some levels includes a little hidden hints that player may encounter. Expect some changes in current puzzles to make them easy to interact but difficult to solve and in next set of levels too.

We’ve attempted to improve the navigation. We hope you’ll feel it made faster now. Music/Sound effect is missing in some areas? Fixed it. We've also reviewed and fixed some gameplay and puzzle issues.

We don’t have anything solid to announce about the updates but we’ve begun working on the next major update which will include additional levels and more improvements.

For OpenXcell Studio,
Amit.
